title: Checkout Snapshot Leaks Into the Live Cart
description:
`Cart.checkout_snapshot()` should return a copy of the cart's items with one-time discounts cleared, for sending to checkout — without touching the live cart. Right now something about the live cart changes too when a snapshot is taken. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Class**
`Cart` with `.add(item)` and `.checkout_snapshot()`

**Expected behavior**
After calling `checkout_snapshot()`, the returned list should have `discount_applied: False` on every item, but `cart.items` (the live cart) should be completely unaffected — same length, same discount flags as before.
